entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:1
segments: ¶"When a man takes a wife and marries her, and it happens that she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some uncleanness in her, and he writes her a certificate of divorce, puts [it] in her hand, and sends her out of his house,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:2
segments: "when she has departed from his house, and goes and becomes another man's [wife],

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:3
segments: "[if] the latter husband detests her and writes her a certificate of divorce, puts [it] in her hand, and sends her out of his house, or if the latter husband dies who took her as his wife,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:4
segments: "[then] her former husband who divorced her must not take her back to be his wife after she has been defiled; for that [is] an abomination before the LORD, and you shall not bring sin on the land which the LORD your God is giving you [as] an inheritance.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:5
segments: ¶"When a man has taken a new wife, he shall not go out to war or be charged with any business; he shall be free at home one year, and bring happiness to his wife whom he has taken.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:6
segments: "No man shall take the lower or the upper millstone in pledge, for he takes [one's] living in pledge.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:7
segments: "If a man is found kidnapping any of his brethren of the children of Israel, and mistreats him or sells him, then that kidnapper shall die; and you shall put away the evil from among you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:8
segments: "Take heed in an outbreak of leprosy, that you carefully observe and do according to all that the priests, the Levites, shall teach you; just as I commanded them, [so] you shall be careful to do.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:9
segments: "Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam on the way when you came out of Egypt.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:10
segments: "When you lend your brother anything, you shall not go into his house to get his pledge.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:11
segments: "You shall stand outside, and the man to whom you lend shall bring the pledge out to you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:12
segments: "And if the man [is] poor, you shall not keep his pledge overnight.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:13
segments: "You shall in any case return the pledge to him again when the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his own garment and bless you; and it shall be righteousness to you before the LORD your God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:14
segments: ¶"You shall not oppress a hired servant [who is] poor and needy, [whether] one of your brethren or one of the aliens who [is] in your land within your gates.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:15
segments: "Each day you shall give [him] his wages, and not let the sun go down on it, for he [is] poor and has set his heart on it; lest he cry out against you to the LORD, and it be sin to you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:16
segments: "Fathers shall not be put to death for [their] children, nor shall the children be put to death for [their] fathers; a person shall be put to death for his own sin.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:17
segments: "You shall not pervert justice due the stranger or the fatherless, nor take a widow's garment as a pledge.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:18
segments: "But you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you from there; therefore I command you to do this thing.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:19
segments: "When you reap your harvest in your field, and forget a sheaf in the field, you shall not go back to get it; it shall be for the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:20
segments: "When you beat your olive trees, you shall not go over the boughs again; it shall be for the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:21
segments: "When you gather the grapes of your vineyard, you shall not glean [it] afterward; it shall be for the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 24:22
segments: "And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt; therefore I command you to do this thing.
